verdict.rationale: Unstructured is a SaaS document-processing platform, so a no-training data commitment or opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never states that customer data is excluded from model training, and it describes no opt-out control. Dedicated or VPC deployments with "full data isolation" and SOC 2/GDPR/HIPAA compliance are related privacy controls, but they do not document a no-training guarantee, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
